description: Structured eval definitions for the KMS Key Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across key specs (symmetric AES-256, RSA_4096 signing, HMAC_256, multi-Region) and prerequisite failure branches (missing root break-glass). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production symmetric AES-256 CMK for data encryption with rotation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — symmetric CMK, separated admins/users, rotation, alias
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a customer-managed KMS key for production data encryption in us-east-1. Alias: alias/payments-cmk. Workload: encrypt EBS volumes, S3 objects, and Secrets Manager secrets for the payments service. Key administrators: the kms-admin IAM role. Key users: the payments-svc IAM role. Enable annual automatic rotation. Deletion window: 30 days. Tags: Environment=production, Application=payments. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEY: alias/payments-cmk
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Key spec — SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT (AES-256-GCM)
  [✓]      Key usage — ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
  [✓]      Origin — AWS_KMS
  [✓]      Key administrators — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-admin (lifecycle actions only, no Encrypt/Decrypt)
  [✓]      Key users — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/payments-svc (Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey)
  [✓]      Root account break-glass — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root (kms:*)
  [✓]      Automatic rotation — enabled (annual)
  [✓]      Alias — alias/payments-cmk
  [✓]      Deletion window — 30 days
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=payments
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/payments-cmk
  aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id alias/payments-cmk
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/payments-cmk --policy-name default
  aws kms list-resource-tags --key-id alias/payments-cmk

eval_cases.name: Key policy omits the account root break-glass — deployment blocker
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a customer-managed KMS key in us-east-1. Alias: alias/audit-cmk. The intended key policy grants kms:Encrypt, kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey*, and kms:* (admin) to the audit-team IAM role, but does NOT include the account root as a break-glass principal. Workload: encrypt audit logs in S3. Deletion window: 7 days. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEY: alias/audit-cmk
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Key spec — SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT (AES-256-GCM)
  [✓]      Key usage — ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
  [✗]      Root account break-glass — MISSING. The key policy does not grant arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root kms:*. Without root break-glass, an accidental policy misconfiguration permanently locks everyone out — AWS support cannot recover the CMK. Add the root statement as the first policy statement.
  [✓]      Key administrators — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-team
  [✓]      Key users — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/audit-team
  [✓]      Deletion window — 7 days (consider increasing to 30 for production)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/audit-cmk --policy-name default
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/audit-cmk

eval_cases.name: RSA_4096 signing key for AWS Signer
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a customer-managed KMS key for code signing in us-east-1. Alias: alias/code-signing-cmk. The key will be used by AWS Signer to sign Lambda deployment packages. Key spec: RSA_4096. Key usage: SIGN_VERIFY. Key administrators: kms-admin role. Key users: the signer-service IAM role. Deletion window: 30 days. Tags: Environment=production, Application=code-signing. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEY: alias/code-signing-cmk
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Key spec — RSA_4096
  [✓]      Key usage — SIGN_VERIFY
  [✓]      Origin — AWS_KMS
  [✓]      Key administrators — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-admin (lifecycle actions only)
  [✓]      Key users — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/signer-service (Sign, Verify)
  [✓]      Root account break-glass — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root (kms:*)
  [✓]      Automatic rotation — not supported for asymmetric keys (manual rotation documented)
  [✓]      Alias — alias/code-signing-cmk
  [✓]      Deletion window — 30 days
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=code-signing
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/code-signing-cmk
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/code-signing-cmk --policy-name default
  aws kms list-aliases --key-id alias/code-signing-cmk
  aws kms list-resource-tags --key-id alias/code-signing-cmk

eval_cases.name: Multi-Region symmetric CMK with replicas for DR
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — multi-Region primary + replicas in us-west-2 + eu-west-1
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a multi-Region customer-managed KMS key for cross-Region disaster recovery in us-east-1. Alias: alias/dr-cmk (primary). Replicate to us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Workload: encrypt DynamoDB global tables data. Key spec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT. Key administrators: kms-admin role. Key users: the dr-service IAM role (in each Region). Deletion window: 30 days. Tags: Environment=production, Application=dr. Account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
KEY: alias/dr-cmk
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓]      Key spec — SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT (AES-256-GCM)
  [✓]      Key usage — ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
  [✓]      Multi-Region — primary in us-east-1, replicas in us-west-2 and eu-west-1
  [✓]      Key administrators — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/kms-admin
  [✓]      Key users — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/dr-service (in us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1)
  [✓]      Root account break-glass — arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root (kms:*)
  [✓]      Automatic rotation — NOT supported for multi-Region keys (manual rotation required)
  [✓]      Replica policies — independent per Region; sync dr-service role in each Region's key policy
  [✓]      Alias — alias/dr-cmk (primary), alias/dr-cmk (per-Region replica aliases)
  [✓]      Deletion window — 30 days
  [✓]      Tags — Environment=production, Application=dr
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/dr-cmk --region us-east-1
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/dr-cmk --region us-west-2
  aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/dr-cmk --region eu-west-1
  aws kms get-key-policy --key-id alias/dr-cmk --policy-name default --region us-east-1
  aws kms list-resource-tags --key-id alias/dr-cmk --region us-east-1
